kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نرتكم (form VIII)
# نَرْتَكِمُ (nartakimu) /nar.ta.ki.mu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِرْتَكَمَ (irtakama)
# نَرْتَكِمَ (nartakima) /nar.ta.ki.ma/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِرْتَكَمَ (irtakama)
# نَرْتَكِمْ (nartakim) /nar.ta.kim/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِرْتَكَمَ (irtakama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
